title: Alibaba Teases Qwen4 Lineup at Apsara, Due Next Week
summary: Alibaba Cloud CTO Feifei Li reportedly said 'Qwen4 next week' at Apsara Amsterdam. The rumored November 2-8, 2026 launch includes Max, Flash, Plus, and 27B.
body_markdown:
#### 💡 TL;DR


- Alibaba Cloud CTO Feifei Li reportedly told attendees at Apsara Amsterdam that Qwen4 would launch next week, meaning November 2-8, 2026.
- A conference slide showed four Qwen4 variants: Max, Flash, Plus, and 27B, though Alibaba has issued no official release date or specifications.
- Qwen Code repository updates reference a one million token context window for Qwen4 identifiers, suggesting technical preparation is underway.


Alibaba's next-generation language model lineup, Qwen4, could arrive as soon as the first week of November 2026. At the Apsara Conference in Amsterdam on October 29, Alibaba Cloud CTO Feifei Li reportedly told the audience "Qwen4 next week," according to attendees posting from the room. A slide projected during Qwen researcher Xudong Guo's talk showed four variants (Max, Flash, Plus, and 27B) with the label "coming soon." Alibaba has not confirmed the date through any official channel.


## Rumored Timeline and Conference Context


The Apsara Conference marked Alibaba Cloud's first European event, held at Amsterdam's Beurs van Berlage. Li's keynote, titled "Alibaba Cloud: The Open Engine for ASI," referenced artificial superintelligence, a long-term goal Alibaba has emphasized in recent months. The phrase "next week" places the rumored launch between November 2 and 8, 2026, though the slide's "coming soon" wording suggests Alibaba retains flexibility on timing.


Alibaba announced tangible milestones at the event: its first Dutch cloud region with two data centers and EU availability for[Qwen3.8-Flash](https://emergent.sh/news/qwen3-8-flash-next-officially-launched-38acb) on Model Studio. Qwen4, however, appeared only in unofficial reports from the room, not in press materials. The Qwen team has a history of surprise releases, often posting weights on Hugging Face without advance notice, making a sudden launch plausible.


## What We Know About Qwen4 Variants


At the September 2026 Apsara Conference in Hangzhou, Alibaba previewed four Qwen4 model names: Max, Flash, Plus, and 27B. No specifications, pricing, or open-weight status was disclosed. The 27B variant follows the pattern of Qwen 2.5 27B, which became one of the most-used open models for local deployment. Recent code commits to Qwen Code, Alibaba's terminal coding agent, reference identifiers including qwen4-max, qwen4-plus, qwen4-coder-plus, and qwen4-omni-120b-think.


A pull request merged on October 28 assigned all Qwen4 identifiers a context window of one million tokens (approximately 750,000 words). The commit author noted the figure came from a reviewer and remains unofficial until Alibaba publishes model cards. If confirmed, this would match or exceed the context capacity of frontier models from OpenAI and Anthropic.


## Expected Release Strategy


Rumored to release on November 2-8, 2026, Qwen4 will likely follow the rollout pattern of Qwen 2.5 and 3.8. Alibaba typically releases smaller variants (Flash, 27B) with open weights on Hugging Face, while larger models (Max, Plus) remain API-only on Model Studio. The 27B model is the most anticipated for developers running AI on local hardware, given the success of Qwen 2.5 27B in community benchmarks.


The qwen4-omni-120b-think identifier suggests a multimodal model with explicit chain-of-thought reasoning, possibly targeting enterprise workflows. Alibaba published Qwen3.8-Flash in August as a technical preview of Qwen4's architecture, a 125-billion-parameter mixture-of-experts model with 51 billion n-gram embeddings. Developers already working with 3.8-Flash may face minimal migration friction.


## Open Model Competition and Global Availability


Qwen4 enters a crowded field of open-weight models from DeepSeek, Meta, and Mistral. October 2026 rankings show strong competition in the 20B-70B parameter range, where Qwen4 27B will need to demonstrate clear advantages in reasoning, multilingual capability, or efficiency. Alibaba's choice of Amsterdam for the tease signals European market intent, though EU availability for Qwen4 has not been confirmed.


The new Dutch cloud region allows EU businesses to keep data in Europe, addressing regulatory concerns. Qwen3.8-Flash is already accessible in the EU via Model Studio. Whether Qwen4 Max and Plus will launch simultaneously in Europe, the US, and other markets outside China remains unclear. Previous Qwen releases often prioritized China and followed weeks later with global API access.


## What This Means


A November 2026 Qwen4 launch would compress the release cycle to roughly four months after Qwen 2.5, suggesting Alibaba is accelerating its model cadence. For developers running local AI, the 27B variant will be the one to watch, assuming open-weight release. Enterprise users may gain access to Max and Plus through Model Studio's pay-per-token pricing. Until Alibaba publishes official model cards on Hugging Face or the Qwen blog, the November 2-8 window remains an unconfirmed timeline drawn from a single stage comment. The million-token context window and multi-variant lineup point to significant capability gains, but benchmarks and real-world testing will determine whether Qwen4 closes the gap with GPT-5 and Claude Opus 5 in reasoning and long-context tasks.
